domain.name: Fintech
domain.rationale: Detected fintech signals from the target URL and release intent.

intents.title: Validate account creation and session entry
intents.rationale: A release demo fails immediately if a new customer cannot create an account and enter the product.
acceptanceCriteria: Customer can submit valid profile details.
Customer lands in the onboarding journey without validation errors.

intents.title: Validate KYC onboarding state progression
intents.rationale: KYC is a fintech identity gate and a common release blocker for onboarding flows.
acceptanceCriteria: KYC status moves to review or approved state with clear messaging.

intents.title: Validate payment success and wallet balance update
intents.rationale: Money movement and balance accuracy have the highest customer and compliance impact.
acceptanceCriteria: Wallet balance reflects the payment amount exactly once.

intents.title: Validate failed or duplicate payment handling
intents.rationale: Duplicate or ambiguous payment states can create financial loss and reconciliation issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid payment input is rejected safely.
Duplicate submission is prevented or clearly handled.

intents.title: Validate refund initiation and status visibility
intents.rationale: Refund errors damage trust and are often tied to legacy regression risk.
acceptanceCriteria: Refund status is visible after submission.

intents.title: Validate fraud decision visibility in payment flow
intents.rationale: Fraud decisions should be visible in shadow/demo mode without blocking good users unexpectedly.
acceptanceCriteria: Fraud risk is calculated before payment completion.
The decision is explainable to the operator or user.

reasoningTrace: Domain Agent detected Fintech with Medium confidence.
Risk Intent Agent generated 6 fintech-aware QA intents.
Used deterministic fallback templates so the demo remains stable.
